evidence: Bumps the C++ language standard to C++23 in CMakeLists.txt, depends, and CI scripts, setting minimum compiler requirements to GCC 13 and Clang 19.
rationale: Raising the minimum language standard to C++23 is a strategically important compiler baseline transition across the project. As the author notes, 'the workarounds to avoid C++23 keep accumulating' and modernizations like #34979 depend on advancing the baseline compiler support.
